idea-plugin.name: DynoTable
idea-plugin.description:
Write SQL and PartiQL for DynamoDB, and SQL and the query DSL for OpenSearch, in JetBrains IDEs. The DynoTable desktop app serves the language features and runs the queries.

  • Completion from your real table schemas and index mappings.
  • Diagnostics with quick fixes, hover, the query plan above each statement, formatting, and rename of table aliases.
  • Run a statement with Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter). The rows show in the DynoTable Results tool window.
  • An explorer of the DynamoDB tables and OpenSearch indices of your DynoTable profile.
  • Open in DynoTable opens the app at the statement's table or index.

Query files: *.dynotable.sql (DynoTable SQL), *.partiql (DynamoDB PartiQL) and *.opensearch (an OpenSearch query). To start, run Tools › DynoTable › New DynoTable Query.

Requirements

  • The DynoTable desktop app, version 1.19.0 or later, on the same computer.
  • The Editor integration switched on in the app: Settings › Editor integration. It is off by default. You do this one time. After that, the plugin starts DynoTable when it needs the app.
  • A trusted project.

Full guide: dynotable.com/docs/editors.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1

  • DynoTable Results is a data grid like the IDE's own: cell, range, row and column selection; Cmd+C (Ctrl+C) copies one cell as its value and more cells as tab-separated text; selection totals in the status bar; sort by the header's sort icon; a filter per column; Find (Cmd+F) with Filter rows; Pin Column; a side panel with Record View and the Value Editor; Copy As CSV, JSON or Markdown; and Export… to a file.
  • The statement text no longer shows above the rows.
  • The plugin has its own icon, and the tool window icons turn white when their tool window is active.

0.1.0: first release. Needs a JetBrains IDE 2026.3 or later and DynoTable 1.19.0 or later.

  • Language features from the DynoTable app for *.dynotable.sql, *.partiql and *.opensearch files: completion, diagnostics with quick fixes, hover, formatting and alias rename. Scratch files and files outside the project get them too.
  • The query plan shows in the lens row above the statement, after Run and Open in DynoTable.
  • Run a statement with the Run lens or Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter). The rows show in the DynoTable Results tool window, with Copy CSV, Copy JSON and Cancel.
  • Open in DynoTable with its lens or Cmd+Shift+Enter (Ctrl+Shift+Enter). Change the shortcuts in Settings › Keymap.
  • Validate against the index, and Stage in DynoTable for PartiQL writes.
  • The DynoTable tool window: an explorer of the profile's DynamoDB tables and OpenSearch indices, with Refresh. A double-click on a table or an index opens a query for it.
  • New Query, Pick OpenSearch Index, Attach SQL File, Select Profile, Reconnect and Open Documentation actions, in Tools › DynoTable.
  • A status bar widget shows the profile, or why DynoTable is not connected and what to do.
  • The SQL files, App path and User data directory settings, in Settings › Tools › DynoTable.
  • Starts DynoTable in the background when it is not running.
